# Aggregator-classifier fixtures for scripts/test_import_dag_contract.py.
#
# The aggregator set is COMPUTED, never hand-listed, so the classifier is the
# single point where a real module could be mistaken for a re-export umbrella
# and thereby stop being a violation source.  Each file below pins one way that
# could go wrong.  See tree_clean.txt for why fixtures ship as a manifest rather
# than as tracked `.lean` files.
#
# Expected classification is encoded in the file name: `Agg*` must be an
# aggregator, `Real*` must not.

--- IsingModel/Fixture/AggPlain.lean
import IsingModel.Fixture.RealPlain

/-!
# A plain re-export umbrella: imports, a doc header, nothing else.
-/

--- IsingModel/Fixture/AggDocMentionsTheorem.lean
import IsingModel.Fixture.RealPlain

/-!
# An umbrella whose doc comment quotes declaration syntax.

theorem thisIsProseNotCode : True := trivial
def neitherIsThis : Nat := 0
-/

--- IsingModel/Fixture/AggEmpty.lean
/-! An umbrella with no imports at all. -/

--- IsingModel/Fixture/AggScaffolding.lean
import IsingModel.Fixture.RealPlain

/-! An umbrella carrying namespace/section scaffolding but no declaration. -/

namespace IsingModel
namespace Ambient
section
open Finset Real
open scoped symmDiff
universe u
variable {V : Type*} [DecidableEq V]
end
end Ambient
end IsingModel

--- IsingModel/Fixture/AggLineComment.lean
import IsingModel.Fixture.RealPlain

-- theorem thisIsALineComment : True := trivial

--- IsingModel/Fixture/RealPlain.lean
/-! One ordinary theorem. -/

theorem realPlain : True := trivial

--- IsingModel/Fixture/RealAttributeOnOneLine.lean
import IsingModel.Fixture.RealPlain

/-!
# Otherwise all imports: the single declaration carries an attribute inline.
-/

@[simp] theorem realAttributeOnOneLine : True := trivial

--- IsingModel/Fixture/RealPrivateNoncomputable.lean
import IsingModel.Fixture.RealPlain

/-! Modifier stack in front of the declaration keyword. -/

private noncomputable def realPrivateNoncomputable : Nat := 0

--- IsingModel/Fixture/RealInstance.lean
import IsingModel.Fixture.RealPlain

/-! A non-`theorem` declaration keyword. -/

instance realInstance : Inhabited Nat := ⟨0⟩

--- IsingModel/Fixture/RealAfterDocBlock.lean
import IsingModel.Fixture.RealPlain

/-!
# The declaration sits after a block comment that must be stripped first.
-/

/-- A doc comment, itself a block comment. -/
theorem realAfterDocBlock : True := trivial

--- IsingModel/Fixture/RealUnsafe.lean
import IsingModel.Fixture.RealPlain

/-! A modifier a declaration-keyword denylist would not have listed. -/

unsafe def realUnsafe : Nat := 0

--- IsingModel/Fixture/RealPartial.lean
import IsingModel.Fixture.RealPlain

/-! Another such modifier. -/

partial def realPartial : Nat := 0

--- IsingModel/Fixture/RealAlias.lean
import IsingModel.Fixture.RealPlain

/-! A declaration command that is not a `def`/`theorem` keyword at all. -/

alias realAlias := realPlain

--- IsingModel/Fixture/RealOpenIn.lean
import IsingModel.Fixture.RealPlain

/-! The `in` combinator: allowlisted scaffolding carrying a declaration. -/

open Nat in theorem realOpenIn : True := trivial

--- IsingModel/Fixture/RealAttribute.lean
import IsingModel.Fixture.RealPlain

/-! An `attribute` command: content, so not a pure re-export index. -/

attribute [simp] realPlain
